sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B on Apple Silicon: MLX Setup, VRAM & Reality
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B runs on Apple Silicon today through MLX. The tag is qwen3.8:27b-mlx in Ollama, added in Ollama v0.32.12, and the 4-bit build downloads at about 18 GB and needs roughly 16-19 GB of unified memory — which makes a 24 GB+ Mac the realistic floor and a 16 GB Mac a no-go. The weights are Apache 2.0, free at the point of use on hardware you own, which is the entire point of the model ...

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B - GitHub
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.
